done_when: A dismissed finding stays dismissed in later rounds while the code its reason cites is unchanged, and returns only when that code changes

known.title: Not done: A dismissed finding stays dismissed in later rounds while the code its reason cites is unchanged, and returns only when that code
Not done: shipped guidance contradicts the new dismissal rule

findings.body:
Gain 4, Work 2, Harm 2
Raise: Not done. The comparison requires the cited line and two neighboring lines on each side to remain together. Editing an adjacent line reopens a finding even when the cited line is unchanged. Also, line 649 treats an identical reason as a carried dismissal: if the cited code changes and the owner dismisses the finding again for the same valid reason, later unchanged commits still compare against the original commit and reopen it. The new test changes only a distant line before checking carry-forward and does not cover either case.
findings.title: Not done: A dismissed finding stays dismissed in later rounds while the code its reason cites is unchanged, and returns only when that code

findings.body:
Gain 3, Work 1, Harm 1
Raise: Not done. Lines 923–924 say a repeat of a dismissed title and file cannot block or start another round. The new text says that same repeat blocks when the cited code changes. This contradiction ships in the template and both host skills, leaving workers with incompatible instructions for the normal changed-code case.
